title: CBP ACE M1 Import Manifest, Appendix F - Schedule K, Foreign Port Codes
changesApplied: Table of changes versions 4.0 (02/2025) to 5.3 (04/2026): codes and names updated, codes added, codes and aliases deleted, Netherland Antilles renamed Curacao, Ivory Coast renamed Cote d'Ivoire.
notApplied: The Army Corps of Engineers quarterly spreadsheets of 2026-04-10 and 2026-07-31 that versions 5.4 and 5.5 point to; supplemental codes for AMS applications only (Canadian provinces, Mexican states, Canadian customs offices, cruise ship codes).
method: Text extracted from the official 2024-08 PDF (1,812,170 bytes, 91 pages): 3,527 port rows by country, names exactly as printed (aliases joined by ';' or ','). Then the change table of the 2026-08 PDF (393,036 bytes, 14 pages) applied; the last column says which change touched the row.
notice: U.S. government work published by U.S. Customs and Border Protection; public domain per the CBP copyright notice (https://www.cbp.gov/site-policy-notices/copyright-notice).
